description: Get an action's full definition including its source code. Secrets found in the code (hard-coded access/secret keys, passwords, tokens, PEM keys) are REDACTED by default and the response carries secretsRedacted=true with the count; pass includeSecrets=true only if you genuinely need the raw values.

actionName.description: Name of the action to retrieve

includeSecrets.description: Return source code unredacted (default false). Even when true, the response still reports how many secret-like values were detected.

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

name: ncloud_functions_get_action
